patterns.message: Import design-system components from '~/ds', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Geist, Geist Mono, Instrument Sans.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, src, size, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Badge> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, size, dot, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Badge> tone must be one of 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'attention' | 'blocked' | 'brand' | 'agent'.
<Badge> size must be one of 'sm' | 'lg'.
<Breadcrumb> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, iconLeft, iconRight, fullWidth, as, onClick, type, disabled, id, name, value, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Button> variant must be one of 'primary' | 'brand' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger'.
<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Callout> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, title, icon, actions, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Callout> tone must be one of 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'attention' | 'blocked' | 'agent'.
<Card> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, subtitle, actions, footer, variant, padded, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Card> variant must be one of 'default' | 'flat' | 'raised' | 'interactive'.
<Checkbox> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, description, onChange, disabled, name, checked, defaultChecked, required, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<DataTableColumn> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: key, header, width, align, cell, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<DataTableColumn> align must be one of 'left' | 'right' | 'center'.
<DescriptionList> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, stacked, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Dialog> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, title, description, width, onClose, footer, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<EmptyState> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, title, description, action, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Field> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, htmlFor, required, optional, hint, error, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Icon> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, size, strokeWidth, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: icon, label, size, bordered, onClick, type, disabled, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<IconButton> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.

<Input> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, icon, suffix, invalid, onChange, onFocus, onBlur, onKeyDown, type, disabled, name, value, defaultValue, placeholder, required, autoComplete, autoFocus, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Input> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Logo> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: size, wordmark, tone, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Logo> tone must be one of 'default' | 'inverse'.
<PageHeader> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, breadcrumbs, meta, actions, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<RadioGroup> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: name, options, value, onChange, row, className, id, tabIndex, role, aria-invalid, aria-describedby, aria-labelledby.
<ReadinessSegment> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: value, tone, label, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<ReadinessSegment> tone must be one of 'ready' | 'attention' | 'blocked' | 'neutral'.
<SearchInput> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: shortcut, size, onChange, onFocus, onBlur, onKeyDown, disabled, name, value, defaultValue, placeholder, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<SearchInput> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Select> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: options, size, onChange, disabled, name, value, defaultValue, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Select> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<SidebarNavItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: id, label, icon, count, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<StatusPill> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: status, size, tone, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<StatusPill> size must be one of 'sm' | 'lg'.
<StatusPill> tone must be one of 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'attention' | 'blocked' | 'brand' | 'agent'.
<Switch> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, onChange, disabled, name, checked, defaultChecked, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<TabItem> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: id, label, icon, count, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Tag> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: color, onRemove, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Textarea> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: invalid, onChange, onFocus, onBlur, disabled, name, value, defaultValue, placeholder, rows, required, id, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Toast> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, icon, actionLabel, onAction, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Toolbar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: left, right, sunken, plus ARIA attributes and role.
<Tooltip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, plus ARIA attributes and role.
